title: Configuration Vocabulary
description: OPTIONAL well-known configuration keys an agent MAY incorporate into its own configSchema, so cross-agent tooling can recognize common knobs uniformly (semantic conventions). An agent's effective configSchema is its own; these are shared shapes, not a required envelope.

SecretRef.title: Secret Reference
SecretRef.description: A reference to a secret resolved by the host out of band (e.g. an environment variable or secret-store key). Secret values MUST NOT be passed inline in configuration.

secretRef.description: Name/key the host resolves to a secret value (e.g. an env var name).

Provider.title: Model Provider Binding
Provider.description: Binds the agent to an LLM provider. Supports provider selection (name a provider the agent supports) and provider injection (supply an OpenAI-compatible endpoint so the agent runs on the consumer's account / 'bring your own model').

kind.description: Provider family. 'openai-compatible' enables injection of an arbitrary base URL.

baseUrl.description: Endpoint for provider injection (OpenAI-compatible). When set, the agent routes LLM calls here.

apiKey.description: Credential for the provider, by reference.

SystemPrompt.title: System Prompt
SystemPrompt.description: Additional or overriding system instructions. Whether the value replaces or augments the agent's base prompt is agent-defined and SHOULD be documented by the agent.

ToolGrant.title: Tool Grant
ToolGrant.description: Grants the agent access to an external tool source. 'mcp' references a Model Context Protocol server.

command.description: Spawn command for a local (e.g. stdio MCP) tool server.

ResourceRef.title: Resource Reference
ResourceRef.description: A context resource (knowledge base, file, dataset) the agent may use.

Limits.title: Resource Limits
Limits.description: Governance bounds the agent SHOULD enforce for work done under this configuration.
